trigger: any required field among sample_id, subject_id, or timepoint is missing or not joinable
allowed_interpretation: cannot establish paired baseline/early samples; no validation result
required_action: run intake/preflight repair or request corrected metadata before scoring

trigger: zero missingness in sample_id, subject_id, and timepoint
allowed_interpretation: pairing fields adequate for downstream gates
required_action: continue to module coverage and subject-map sanity

trigger: treatment_relative_day missing but unambiguous baseline/early labels exist
allowed_interpretation: early sample selection is label-based rather than exact-day based
required_action: report as timing limitation; do not create alternative timepoint rule

trigger: treatment_relative_day missing and multiple on-treatment samples could be early candidates
allowed_interpretation: early feature may be selected ambiguously
required_action: block scoring until author clarifies earliest eligible sample or write blind addendum before scoring

trigger: at least one major processing batch field is present for all scored samples and not perfectly confounded with response
allowed_interpretation: batch guard can be interpreted
required_action: report batch diagnostic normally

trigger: major batch field present but missing in <=25% scored samples or partially aliased with response
allowed_interpretation: batch audit is informative but incomplete
required_action: report limitation; raw pass cannot be described as technically clean without caveat

trigger: no major batch field present, or >25% missing, but QC fields are present
allowed_interpretation: batch false-positive risk cannot be ruled out directly
required_action: report batch diagnostic as unavailable; emphasize synthetic batch-risk boundary

trigger: batch/sample metadata contradicts sample IDs or indicates unresolved response-correlated processing split
allowed_interpretation: technical confounding could dominate the result
required_action: block clean pass; request metadata repair or author-run clarification

trigger: steroid_exposure_recent and steroid_last_dose_days present or explicitly absent for all scored subjects
allowed_interpretation: clinical steroid confounding can be interpreted alongside expression signature
required_action: report steroid metadata audit normally

trigger: one of steroid_exposure_recent or steroid_last_dose_days present, or <=25% missing
allowed_interpretation: steroid audit is partly clinical and partly expression-signature based
required_action: report limitation; do not claim direct steroid exclusion

trigger: both primary steroid fields absent but relapse/acute-treatment context present
allowed_interpretation: can only use expression glucocorticoid signature and acute-treatment proxy
required_action: report V32-style expression audit only; raw pass is not clean steroid-metadata-adjusted

trigger: steroid fields conflict with timepoint/outcome labels or acute steroid pulse cannot be assigned to samples
allowed_interpretation: steroid exposure is too ambiguous for confounder interpretation
required_action: block clean interpretation until repaired; do not tune or exclude samples post hoc

trigger: rin_or_rna_quality and sequencing_depth_or_reads or platform-equivalent QC present for all scored samples
allowed_interpretation: QC covariates can be audited
required_action: report QC/batch diagnostics normally

trigger: QC fields present with <=25% missingness
allowed_interpretation: QC audit is informative but incomplete
required_action: report missingness and do sensitivity only if preregistered

trigger: core QC fields absent but sample-level processing metadata exists
allowed_interpretation: QC cannot be directly audited
required_action: report as unavailable; do not infer quality from outcome results

trigger: CBC or direct cell-composition covariates present, or expression-based composition scores pass coverage
allowed_interpretation: composition confounding can be audited
required_action: report cell-composition audit normally

trigger: CBC/direct counts absent but expression markers pass coverage
allowed_interpretation: composition audit relies on expression-marker proxy
required_action: state proxy limitation explicitly

trigger: CBC/direct counts absent and expression-marker coverage inadequate
allowed_interpretation: cell-composition confounding cannot be assessed
required_action: report cell-composition audit unavailable; no clean composition-adjusted claim

trigger: all core fields pass; batch, steroid, QC, and composition are green or only one yellow
allowed_interpretation: metadata do not impose additional interpretation downgrade
required_action: use V42 result class from frozen harness and report rubric

trigger: core fields pass; two or more panels are yellow, none orange/red
allowed_interpretation: validation can be scored but clean interpretation needs caveats
required_action: report limitations; do not overstate technical/steroid exclusion

trigger: core fields pass; one or more panels orange and none red
allowed_interpretation: validation may be scored but a positive result is technically/confounder bounded
required_action: report as bounded/non-clean according to V42 grid and audit outputs

trigger: any core red, or unresolved red in batch/steroid/QC/composition required to interpret the result
allowed_interpretation: no clean validation result
required_action: block or classify UNSCOREABLE_DATA
